title: Zyntra
description: Zyntra is a Fabric Minecraft mod that turns your game into a server management hub with an integrated dashboard to create, control, and monitor servers through a fast and modern interface.

# Zyntra

Zyntra is a mod for building your own server on your computer and managing it directly from Minecraft without any external software.

## How does it work?

- Create your server
- Choose your name, version, loader, and the amount of RAM used.

- Launch the server or install your mods and plugins.

## Why use Zyntra?

Zyntra is simple for people who don't have much experience creating servers.
